'''Holocomputers''' were specialized [[Computer/Legends|computers]] that fed information to [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]] so that the images could be controlled from a central location. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Janus Bonn]] used holocomputers to control the various holoprojectors positioned around the remains of the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] when setting a trap for the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]].
